status.label: Tracked by the reproducible underscore-remap issue
status.detail: The requested '-' to '_' behavior matches the same shift/minus remapping failure already tracked in open, maintainer-reproducible issue #27508.

judgment.rationale: Issue #37470 asks for the physical '-' key to produce '_' and Shift+'-' to produce '-', but reports that the mapping always produces '_'. Open issue #27508 gives the same two remaps (Shift+'-' to '-' and '-' to Shift+'-'), expects underscore, and has the Status-Reproducible label. The shared input/output sequence and failure are the same; #27508 is the more complete existing tracking item, so creating a second design would split reports rather than advance the fix.
evidence: The #37470 reporter lists PowerToys 0.88.0 and requests '-' -> '_' and Shift+'-' -> '-'; they say the output remains '_' regardless of the attempted configuration.
The only #37470 comment is an automated similar-issue suggestion linking #27508.
Open #27508 reproduces the same behavior with mappings Shift+'-' -> '-' and '-' -> Shift+'-'; it expects underscore but receives '-'.
#27508 is labeled Status-Reproducible and remains open, making it the existing maintainer-tracked report for this remapping failure.
The reports differ in PowerToys version but describe the same shifted-minus/underscore remapping case.
judgment.recommended_action: Keep the exact current-version report in #27508 and avoid parallel fix work for #37470.

fix_assessment.rationale: This report duplicates the same remapping failure already tracked in open, maintainer-reproducible #27508; no competing fix should be created.
